infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Huddle reads your weight, body fat, lean mass, steps, energy burned, and food energy from Health so your coach dashboards stay up to date automatically — no more manual logging or Shortcuts.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Huddle does not write anything back to Health. This permission is requested by the Health framework but unused.
